articles.title: Bitcoin resilience tested as U.S. dollar climbs to 18-month high
articles.snippet: A stronger dollar and rising bond yields could be headwinds as fiscal concerns in France and political uncertainty in Spain weigh on the euro.

articles.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade launches on Sepolia testnet
articles.snippet: Sepolia marks one of the final major rehearsals before the final activation of Glamsterdam, aimed at bringing more efficiency and scalability to the Ethereum mainnet.

articles.title: US crypto rules need to survive the next election
articles.snippet: US crypto rules could be vulnerable to political change after the midterms. Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo argues Congress needs to pass durable, bipartisan legislation.

articles.title: Solana Debuts Institutional Settlement Standard With J.P. Morgan Input
articles.snippet: Built with input from J.P. Morgan, the open-source "DvP" program lets institutions settle trades atomically on Solana with finality in seconds instead of days.

articles.title: SEC Clears 3x Leveraged Bitcoin and Ethereum Funds for Trading
articles.snippet: The agency approved a Cboe rule letting six Volatility Shares funds that triple the daily moves of Bitcoin, Ethereum, gold, silver, oil, and natural gas list on a U.S. exchange.
